.qc-cache/hireops-live-desk-2026-10-02-r1/task/environment/assets/seed_data.json (parsed, all top-level keys and note fields)
evidence: Source review of the frozen bytes; no agent image was built or inspected by this reviewer. (1) task/environment/ contains exactly Dockerfile, assets/seed_data.json, instructions/hireops_rules.md and instructions/integration.md; the Docker build context is environment/, so solution/ and tests/ are unreachable. (2) environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template Dockerfile (diff empty): lines 14-15 COPY only instructions/ and assets/; lines 16-23 create /app, git init, and commit only .gitkeep. No COPY of solution or tests, no starter, skeleton or partial UI. (3) seed_data.json holds inputs only: reference_moment, constants, 3 employees, 7 users, 7 requisitions, 13 offers and demonstration ledger rows (seed_commitments, seed_equity_grants, seed_remittances, seed_referral_accruals); offer and requisition note fields are all empty; no SQL schema, no route list, no precomputed coordinated-change results. It is the same file the golden ships (sha256 1b390154...18bcf7 for both environment/assets/seed_data.json and solution/app/src/seed_data.json), which is an input copy, not a deliverable. (4) grep of environment/ and instruction.md for CREATE TABLE, app.get/post, and /api/ finds only GET /api/health (integration.md:9, instruction.md:15); hireops_rules.md:53 and :436-437 explicitly leave routes, field names and schemas to the builder. (5) Grader-vocabulary grep (judge|rubric|criteri|dimension|reward|weight|score.py|playwright|glm|claude|/tests|sentinel|probe) over instruction.md and environment/ hits only ordinary domain prose (hireops_rules.md:20 'amortized weight', :170 'budget gate', :408 'dashboard') plus the health route. (6) Longest contiguous word run shared between any tests/ prompt, judge.toml or app_context.md and /instructions files is 10 words (tests/scored/polish/judge.toml vs hireops_rules.md:555-556 'the offending field when the explanation sits at that field'; tests/scored/functional/prompt.md vs hireops_rules.md:439 'each member's old/new run-rate, signing adjustment and'); these are shared requirement phrases, not reproduced criterion text or rubric. Adversarial reading: a broken app cannot be assembled from the environment, since the rules give business formulas and behaviours (the ask) but no code, schema or UI; a conforming alternative is not disadvantaged by this row.
